title: [Dependabot] GHSA-6w46-j5rx-g56g in pytest
description:
## pytest has vulnerable tmpdir handling

**Provider:** GitHub Dependabot
**Repository:** `AnthusAI/Biblicus`
**Alert Number:** 82
**Severity:** medium
**State:** open
**Package:** `pytest`
**Ecosystem:** `pip`
**Manifest:** `poetry.lock`

### Advisory
pytest through 9.0.2 on UNIX relies on directories with the `/tmp/pytest-of-{user}` name pattern, which allows local users to cause a denial of service or possibly gain privileges.

### Reference
- https://github.com/AnthusAI/Biblicus/security/dependabot/82

comments.text: Remediation implemented in poetry.lock: pytest updated to 9.0.3 (first patched version for GHSA-6w46-j5rx-g56g).
